review.title: HT RW8: scoped species-name GTDB correspondence diagnostic
review.independence_basis: The source context, local authority rows and complete native name-fallback population were read before staging. Parent independently read the exact source plan, accepted candidate and receipt. A separate peer source pass identified record 392's conflicting R232 dispositions; the replacement nine-record plan excludes that whole record. This is the first real name-fallback canary for the replacement plan.
review.summary: The existing Bacillus vallismortis RW8 descriptor now carries the native species-name GTDB correspondence with one reference genome and fraction 1.0. The native crosswalk has no row for species identifier 72361, so this is explicitly the ncbi_name fallback, not an exact-stock genome assignment. Actual guarded M5 application, append-only native history and eight scoped native commands are bound. HT membership, RW5, source quotations and all existing biological claims remain unchanged.
review.scope_description: One selected taxonomy descriptor's GTDB block/status, its source-species and reference-population boundary, and actual application/check/history provenance. Other biological claims remain outside new scientific certification.
review.selection: One whole record, CommunityMech:000347, is the first actual name-fallback canary of the replacement nine-record plan. Record 392 is explicitly held under issue 2877; none of the remaining eight records was applied before this canary's saved proof and complete input checkpoint.
limitations: Partial technical and provenance assessment with scientific_review:false; neither full scientific record approval nor a corpus QC pass is inferred from native checks.

The inspected primary-source cache contains the abstract and labeled Figure 4 composition/16S transcriptions. This pass did not newly inspect the figure image, full methods/results or supplements. The retained transcription supports the narrow HT/RW8 context only within that declared coverage.

NCBITaxon:72361 is the source species identity. The current crosswalk has no exact species-ID row and resolves the same species name through one reference genome. OQ996934 is a 16S accession, not an assembly; experimental stock RW8 is not assigned that reference genome.

The table's exact SHA256 binds its bytes. File mtime is not a release date, and this diagnostic does not certify an upstream GTDB release. Local NCBI file-stat observations are not a content hash or a database release assertion.

The unselected RW5 block, all original source quotations, three current biological endpoints and absence of causal arrows remain unchanged. Mapping does not resolve the retained source-plan issues 2352–2356/2360 concerning endpoints, timing, gene panels, cultivation, aliases or historical prose.

Seven scoped validators plus native history scaffolding are separate from source-snippet comparison, generated pages, strict historical successor admission and combined full QC. Those integration outcomes remain independently accounted.

Original ten-record preparation 001 remains historical evidence. The replacement 002 plan preserves the whole-record 392 hold for its deliberate R232 manual dispositions rather than replacing them with this older crosswalk's result.

assessments.topic: Preserved HT and RW8 source identity
assessments.summary: Preserve RW8 as the B. vallismortis member of the two-strain HT community, keeping RW5 and five-member C2 distinct. The available primary cache supports only the declared abstract/transcription coverage. The 16S label does not establish a stock-genome identity.

The exact crosswalk and native resolver reproduce the name-fallback species correspondence with one reference genome and fraction 1.0. No exact species-ID row, experimental-stock assembly membership, additional genotype or formal nomenclatural change is inferred. Existing NCBI identity and source stock remain unchanged.
